title: Understanding KDE
text: A Kernel Density Estimate (KDE) is a way to estimate the probability density function of a random variable. It involves placing a kernel, which is a smooth, symmetric function, at each data point.

title: Role of Bandwidth in KDE
text: The bandwidth parameter in a KDE controls how smooth or wiggly the resulting curve is. A larger bandwidth results in a smoother curve, while a smaller bandwidth can capture more detail but may also introduce noise.
